description: Declares Microtheory -has_target_arousal-> TargetArousal as an admissible edge -- the one new graph-structural piece domains/shared_arousal.py needs. The actual excitation-transfer DECISION (how much a co-target incident's evidence moves a belief) is entirely the pre-existing concept_apply_evidence PyO3 op + can_native_update_3state's own relaxation -- no rule is added here, only admissibility. See SHARED_AROUSAL_EXCITATION_TRANSFER_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md.

concepts.name: shared_arousal_excitation_transfer
concepts.definition: Arousal connected to a specific target is a single, valence-blind pool shared by every belief update about that target -- a hostile incident and a desire-relevant incident toward the SAME person draw from and contribute to the SAME arousal level, so elevated arousal from one amplifies the effective evidence strength of the other, purely from co-occurrence, not from any change to the evidence itself.
concepts.why: User: 'the concept of hatefucking needs to work' -- scoped as an abstract arousal-sharing mechanism (Zillmann 1971/1983 excitation transfer; Dutton & Aron 1974), not narrative content. SHARED_AROUSAL_EXCITATION_TRANSFER_PREREG.md.
